fr_html: Le PRESIDENT, conformément à l'ordre du jour adopté pour la séance, ouvre la discussion sur la question de l'organisation de la Cour. Il a fait distribuer aux membres un avant-projet qui a le caractère d'une transaction entre les diverses opinions qui se sont manifestées. (Annexe 1er). Il croit qu'il sera facile de combiner la discussion de cet avant-projet avec celle des projets déposés par Mr. Root et Lord Phillimore, et par M. Ricci-Busatti.
en_html: The PRESIDENT, in accordance with the Agenda adopted for the meeting, opened the discussion of the question of the organisation of the Court. He had had distributed to the members a draft scheme which was in the nature of a compromise between the various motions which had been put forward. (Annex 1). He thought it would be easy to combine the discussion of this draft scheme with that of the schemes submitted by Mr. Root and Lord Phillimore, and by M. Ricci-Busatti.
